### `logic.src.policies.routing.meta_heuristics.simulated_annealing_neighborhood_search.common.__init__`

Common utilities and structures for Simulated Annealing Neighborhood Search (SANS).

### `logic.src.policies.routing.meta_heuristics.simulated_annealing_neighborhood_search.common.check`

Consistency and feasibility validation for look-ahead routing solutions.

- `check_bins_overflowing_feasibility()` — Check if the solution is feasible regarding the number of overflowing bins.
- `check_solution_admissibility()` — Verify if all bins are accounted for in the routes or removed set.

### `logic.src.policies.routing.meta_heuristics.simulated_annealing_neighborhood_search.common.distance`

Distance and time calculations for SANS.

- `compute_distance_per_route()` — Calculate the total travel distance for each individual route.
- `compute_route_time()` — Estimate total duration of each route (collection time + travel time).
- `compute_sans_route_cost()` — Calculate the travel cost/distance for a single route using id-to-index mapping.
- `compute_total_cost()` — Calculate total travel distance for all routes.

### `logic.src.policies.routing.meta_heuristics.simulated_annealing_neighborhood_search.common.objectives`

Objective functions for SANS.

- `compute_profit()` — Calculate the total objective value (Profit - Penalties).
- `compute_real_profit()` — Calculate the "real" profit (Revenue - Travel Cost - Vehicle penalty)
- `compute_total_profit()` — Calculate the total profit considering:

### `logic.src.policies.routing.meta_heuristics.simulated_annealing_neighborhood_search.common.penalties`

Cost and penalty calculations for SANS.

- `compute_transportation_cost()` — Calculate the total transportation cost based on distance and cost coefficient.
- `compute_vehicle_use_penalty()` — Calculate the penalty for the number of vehicles (routes) used.
- `compute_route_time_difference_penalty()` — Calculate penalty for workload imbalance between routes.
- `compute_shift_excess_penalty()` — Calculate penalty for routes exceeding the shift duration.
- `compute_load_excess_penalty()` — Calculate penalty for vehicles exceeding their capacity limit.

### `logic.src.policies.routing.meta_heuristics.simulated_annealing_neighborhood_search.common.revenue`

Revenue calculations for SANS.

- `compute_waste_collection_revenue()` — Calculate the total revenue from waste collected in the current routes.

### `logic.src.policies.routing.meta_heuristics.simulated_annealing_neighborhood_search.common.routes`

Route manipulation utilities for SANS.

- `create_points()` — Create a mapping of bin IDs to their coordinates.
- `uncross_arcs_in_routes()` — Improve routes by uncrossing arcs while maintaining profit constraints.
- `rearrange_part_route()` — Select a random portion of a route and reorder it using a greedy Nearest Neighbor heuristic.
- `organize_route()` — Construct a route from a set of bins using the Nearest Neighbor heuristic.
- `two_opt_uncross_arc()` — Apply 2-opt local search to a single route to remove arc crossings.
- `uncross_arcs_in_sans_routes()` — Apply 2-opt uncrossing to all routes in a solution.

### `logic.src.policies.routing.meta_heuristics.simulated_annealing_neighborhood_search.common.solution_initialization`

Initialization strategies for vehicle routing solutions.

- `find_initial_solution()` — Construct a feasible initial solution for the routing problem.
- `compute_initial_solution()` — Simplified initial solution builder for SANS policy.

### `logic.src.policies.routing.meta_heuristics.simulated_annealing_neighborhood_search.common.update`

Temporal state transition and bin accumulation logic for simulation days.

- `should_bin_be_collected()` — Check if a bin's fill level will exceed MAX_CAPACITY_PERCENT% by the next day.
- `add_bins_to_collect()` — Predictively identify bins that will overflow before the next planned
- `update_fill_levels_after_first_collection()` — Simulate bin emptying after collection by resetting fill levels to zero.
- `initialize_lists_of_bins()` — Initialize a zeroed list for tracking next collection days.
- `calculate_next_collection_days()` — Calculate how many days remain until each mandatory bin overflows again.
- `get_next_collection_day()` — Determine the minimum number of days until the first bin in the set overflows.

- `execute_og()` — Execute the original LAC (look-ahead collection) engine.

### `logic.src.policies.routing.meta_heuristics.simulated_annealing_neighborhood_search.heuristics.sans_neighborhoods`

Local search neighborhood operators for SANS-style optimization.

- `get_neighbors()` — Generate the neighborhood of a route through node swaps.
- `get_2opt_neighbors()` — Generate 2-opt neighbors for a route.
- `relocate_within_route()` — Relocate a random bin to a different position in the same route.
- `cross_exchange()` — Exchange segments between two different routes.
- `or_opt_move()` — Apply Or-opt operator (move a segment of 1-2 nodes) within a route.
- `move_between_routes()` — Move a random bin from one route to another, respecting capacity constraints.
- `insert_bin_in_route()` — Insert a bin into a route at the position minimizing cost increase.
- `mutate_route_by_swapping_bins()` — Swap random nodes within a route.

- `move_n_route_random()` — Move n random bins from one route to another.
- `swap_n_route_random()` — Swap n random bins between two distinct routes.
- `remove_n_bins_random()` — Remove n random bins from routes and add them to the removed pool.
- `add_n_bins_random()` — Add n random bins from the removed pool back into routes.
- `add_route_with_removed_bins_random()` — Create a new route from random bins in the removed pool.

- `swap_n_route_consecutive()` — Swap consecutive segments between two routes.
- `remove_n_bins_consecutive()` — Remove a consecutive sequence of bins from a route.
- `add_n_bins_consecutive()` — Add a sequence of bins from removed set as a consecutive segment.
- `add_route_with_removed_bins_consecutive()` — Alias for random version as 'consecutive' doesn't strictly apply to a sequence
